actions: identical long and short direct 24-bp account-return counterfactuals
entry: fixed 500 ms represented by first strictly later observable one-minute open

selection: 2021 fit context, 2022 forward selection, unchanged 2023 confirmation; q=0.97 selected only because both years were positive, PF>1, non-sparse and positive after exact winner-event deletion with full rerouting at 24 bp
official: annual expanding refit with six-hour new-year release delay; continuous 2024-01-01 through 2026-06-30
